environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (10.0.128.0/18, 10.0.192.0/18) within vpc-0a3f7c9e2b1d4. The service is fronted by an internal NLB (scheme: internal) with no public-facing listener. Access is exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f8a3b7c1d2e4f5a6) configured with a whitelist of 3 allowed principal ARNs corresponding to internal service accounts. The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. Security groups on the Fargate ENIs restrict ingress to TCP/8443 from the NLB's private IPs only (sg-0abc123def456 allows 10.0.64.0/26 on 8443). DNS resolution for the endpoint is private-only via Route53 private hosted zone. The endpoint service requires manual acceptance of connection requests.

config.infrastructure: ECS Fargate, private subnets, internal NLB
config.network: No IGW, no NAT-GW, no peering, no public route table entries
config.endpoint_policy: Principal whitelist: 3 internal service account ARNs only
config.dns: Private hosted zone, no public resolution
